property_summary: After a call to fallback() with exactly 10 ether, when block.timestamp is exactly equal to pastBlockTime (the edge case), the reference contract requires block.timestamp > pastBlockTime and reverts, while the buggy contract does not revert (since it sets pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1, allowing the transaction to go through), leading to a different value of pastBlockTime.

After a fallback call with 10 ether at block.timestamp == pastBlockTime, reference reverts while buggy contract proceeds, leading to pastBlockTime being unchanged in reference but set to block.timestamp + 1 in buggy.
